hypotheses.L2_tangent_effect_is_context_linear: At 10 percent scale, the context-linear term has at least 80 percent median norm share on both corpora.
hypotheses.L3_full_effect_is_mostly_context_linear: At full scale, the context-linear term has at least 60 percent median norm share on both corpora.
hypotheses.L4_linear_term_is_behaviorally_sufficien: At full scale, the context-linear-only patch reaches at least 0.70 median downstream fidelity to the exact projected bank patch on both corpora.
hypotheses.L5_quadratic_term_is_nontrivial: At full scale, the within-edit quadratic term has at least 5 percent median norm share on both corpora.
hypotheses.L6_current_context_is_necessary: Replacing the current base context with the leave-one-pair-out discovery mean lowers downstream fidelity by at least 0.20 on both corpora at full scale.
hypotheses.L7_polynomial_regime_transfers_ood: The TinyStories full-scale context-linear norm share is within 0.15 of FineWeb.
